The issuer displays significant operational distress and severe profitability pressures, evidenced by an extremely thin operating margin ($12M EBIT on $15,796M revenue) and a net loss of $236M. However, it retains a substantial equity cushion ($4,284M) and positive working capital ($4,592M current assets vs. $3,796M current liabilities), which provides temporary downside protection against immediate default. Balancing the weak earnings capacity and high leverage with the existing capital buffer aligns the company with a speculative-grade rating.

DECISION: BB-
